nodes.label: No steps yet. Each step — one chord or action.

Build reusable sequences of key chords, text, commands and system actions. Use a unique ID in macro:<id> references and a readable name in action lists. Assign macros on the Layers or Triggers tab; change an ID only when it is unused.

The step pause applies between steps of this macro. Modifier delay is the time between pressing a modifier and the main key. Leave delays empty to use Settings defaults.
Global defaults: step pause 20 ms; modifier delay 5 ms.
